title: Israeli Election 2013: Netanyahu and Lieberman launch right-wing alliance
description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Foreign Minister Avigdor Lieberman have launched their joint election campaign in Jerusalem with the creation of a right wing alliance.  Netanyahu's Likud has joined forces with Lieberman's ultranationalist Beitenu party and although opinion polls showed a dip in support after Israeli prosecutors said they would charge Lieberman with breach of trust, an accusation the ex-foreign minister denies, the alliance is expected to win a solid majority on January 22nd.
